title.zh: 在总审计局设立一个部门与新增职位并为其运作提供资金的法案
title.en: An Act Creating a Department and Additional Positions in the General Auditing Office and Providing Funds for the Operation Thereof
title.orig: An Act Creating a Department and Additional Positions in the General Auditing Office and Providing Funds for the Operation Thereof

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2697_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
There is hereby created a department under the Office of the Auditor General, General Auditing Office, to be known as the Program Audit Department, with the following positions and appropriation for its operation:
I. Personal Services
A. For new positions:
One chief supervising auditor at P7,236 per annum ₱7,236.00 Two supervising auditors at ₱6,552 per annum 13,104.00 Two auditors IV at ₱5,928 per annum 11,856.00 Seven auditors III at P5,112 per annum 35,784.00 Four auditors III at ₱4,800 per annum 19,200.00 Two auditors II at ₱4,404 per annum 8,808.00 Two auditors II at ₱3,960 per annum 7,920.00 Six Auditing Examiners II at ₱2,760 per annum 16,560.00 Eight auditing examiners I at ₱2,400 per annum 19,200.00 Two stenographers at ₱1,800 per annum 3,600.00 Two clerical aides at ₱1,440 per annum 2,880.00 Total for new positions ₱146,148.00 =============
B. For adjustment of salaries of key personnel to make them conform with salaries of other officials of equal rank in the General Auditing Office ₱6,302.40 Total for personal services ₱152,450.40 ============= II. Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses Commutable transportation allowance of manager (similar to that given to other managers of the General Auditing Office) 1,200.00 Travel expenses 20,000.00 Supplies and materials 5,000.00 Total maintenance and operating expenses 26,200.00 ============= III. Furniture and Equipment Equipment outlay ₱10,000.00 Total for furniture and equipment ₱10,000.00 ============= IV. Summary Total for personal services ₱152,450.40 Total for maintenance and other operating expenses 26,200.00 Total for furniture and equipment 10,000.00 Total appropriations for the Program Audit Department of the General Auditing Office ₱188,650.40 =============

There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the amount of one hundred eighty-eight thousand, six hundred fifty pesos and forty centavos for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-one. The corresponding appropriation for the succeeding fiscal years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect on July 1, 1960.
Approved, June 18, 1960.
